hindi: ज्ञातिजन, पड़ोसी तथा धनी लोग क्रम से भूमि-सम्पत्तियों को खरीदने में प्रबल हों।
english: Kinsmen, neighbours and wealthy men should, in order, prevail to buy the land-holdings.
notes: abhi-ā-√bhū is rare; "prevail" is a literal-leaning rendering, "take precedence" is the likely sense. dhanika: wealthy man; "creditor" is another possible sense. sāmanta rendered "neighbour" (not "neighbouring chief"), as the context is landed property.

hindi: उसके बाद दूसरे, बाहरी लोग।
english: Then others, outsiders.
notes: Elliptical; continues the order of precedence of unit 1 (verb understood from there).

words.gloss: according to the use of the embankments

hindi: पड़ोसियों के चालीस कुल्यों के बीच, घर के सामने के स्थान पर, आवास की घोषणा सुनवाएँ; पड़ोसी गाँवों के वृद्धों के बीच, सीमाओं के भीतर, सेतुओं के उपभोग के अनुसार, खेत, उद्यान, सेतु-बन्ध, तालाब अथवा जलाशय की घोषणा सुनवाएँ: “इस मूल्य पर कौन खरीदार है?”
english: Among the neighbours' forty kinsmen, [at a place] facing the house, they should have the dwelling proclaimed; among the elders of the neighbouring villages, within the boundaries, according to the use of the embankments, [they should have] the field, garden, embankment-dam, tank or reservoir [proclaimed]: "At this price, who is the buyer?"
notes: Doubtful: sāmanta-catvāriṃśat-kulyeṣu could be "among the neighbours and forty kinsmen" or "among forty families of the neighbourhood"; kulya rendered kinsman (glossary). gṛha-pratimukhe: "facing / opposite the house" (the exact place of proclamation is not stated). yathā-setu-bhogam: "according to the use of the embankments" is literal; the sense is not settled. The verb śrāvayeyuḥ is gapped in the second clause; the supplied words are bracketed in English only. setu-bandha taken as one item (embankment-dam), cf. units 28, 32, 33. The proclamation is a quotation closed by iti, carried by the quotation marks.

hindi: जो तीन बार घोषित किया गया हो और जिसमें बाधा न आई हो, उसे खरीदार खरीद पाए।
english: The buyer may get to buy [what is] proclaimed three times [and] unobstructed.
notes: The object of kretum is not named (understood from unit 3); āghuṣitam avyāhatam read as neuter accusatives agreeing with it.

words.gloss: in the raising of the price

hindi: अथवा स्पर्धा से मूल्य बढ़ने पर, मूल्य की वृद्धि शुल्क सहित कोश में जाए।
english: Or, when the price is raised through rivalry, the increase in price, together with the duty, should go to the treasury.
notes: śulka rendered "duty" (toll/duty elsewhere in the book).

words.gloss: one who cries out against the sale

hindi: बिक्री के विरुद्ध पुकारने वाला शुल्क दे।
english: The one who cries out against the sale should pay the duty.
notes: pratikroṣṭṛ / pratikrośa (units 6-9): "crying out against" is literal; it may mean a counter-bid or a protest. The sense is not settled.

words.gloss: in a crying out against by a non-owner

hindi: जो स्वामी नहीं है उसके द्वारा विरोध में पुकारे जाने पर चौबीस पण का दण्ड है।
english: In a crying out against [it] by a non-owner, the penalty is one of twenty-four paṇas.
notes: asvāmi-pratikrośe could also be read "when the one crying out is a non-owner"; same sense.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. an-abhi-√sṛ

hindi: सात रात के बाद, पास न आने वाले की स्थिति में, जिसके विरुद्ध पुकारा गया है वह बेच सकता है।
english: After seven nights, [in the case] of one not approaching, the one cried against may sell.
notes: Unclear who is who: anabhisarataḥ (genitive, "of one not approaching") probably refers to the person who cried out; pratikruṣṭaḥ may be the seller or the thing cried against. The rendering is literal.

words.gloss: in transgression of what was cried against
in the case of a homestead

hindi: वास्तु के विषय में पुकारे गए का उल्लंघन होने पर दो सौ का दण्ड है; अन्यत्र चौबीस पण का दण्ड है। ९। यह वास्तु की बिक्री है।
english: On transgression of what was cried against, in the case of a homestead the penalty is one of two hundred; elsewhere the penalty is one of twenty-four paṇas. 9. Such is the sale of homesteads.
notes: The unit contains the verse number "| 9 |" inside the line (kept as tokens). dviśataḥ: no unit stated for the two hundred. vāstu: "homestead / dwelling site". Closing iti on a section label: "Such is ...", as in the glossary for 5.3 and 9.3.

hindi: दोनों गाँवों के सीमा-विवाद को पड़ोसी, अर्थात् पाँच गाँवों का समूह अथवा दस गाँवों का समूह, स्थिर या कृत्रिम सेतुओं से निपटाए।
english: The neighbours of both villages, [namely] a group of five villages or of ten villages, should settle the boundary dispute by means of embankments, fixed or artificial.

text_flags.why: possible: visarga missing; before the voiceless p of pañca the visarga would stay; the plural nominative sāmantāḥ is expected. (sāmantā as a feminine singular is less likely.)

notes: sīma-vivādaṃ kuryāt: literally "should make the boundary dispute"; rendered "settle" (idiom). setu = embankment (boundary embankment), as in the glossary. The relation of pañca-grāmī / daśa-grāmī to sāmantāḥ (apposition: a group of 5 or 10 villages) is uncertain. The singular kuryāt agrees with the singular group noun.

hindi: किसान, गोपालक और वृद्ध, अथवा पहले उपभोग करने वाले, अथवा सेतुओं को जानने वाले बाहरी लोग, बहुत से या एक, सीमा के सेतुओं को बताकर, बदले हुए वेश में, सीमा तक ले जाएँ।
english: Farmers, cowherds and elders, or former enjoyers, or outsiders who know the embankments, many or one, having indicated the boundary embankments, in changed dress, should lead [to] the boundary.
notes: karṣaka-go-pālaka-vṛddhāḥ may also be "elders among farmers and cowherds". pūrva-bhuktikāḥ: "those who formerly had the enjoyment (of the land)"; the sense of -bhuktika is not settled. viparīta-veṣāḥ literally "with reversed / contrary dress", probably "in disguise". sīmānaṃ nayeyuḥ: literally "should lead the boundary"; "[to]" is supplied. Printed pūrva.bhuktikā, abhijñā, bahava are regular sandhi (visarga lost before a voiced sound), no flag.

hindi: बताए गए सेतुओं के न दिखने पर एक हज़ार का दण्ड है।
english: When the indicated embankments are not seen, the penalty is a thousand.
notes: No unit given for the thousand. Whom the penalty falls on (the guides) is not stated.

hindi: उसी के ले जाए जाने पर सीमा हटाने वालों और सेतु काटने वालों के लिए किया जाए।
english: When that very [thing] has been led, [it] should be done for the boundary-removers and the embankment-cutters.
notes: Obscure. tad eva probably points back to the penalty of unit 12 (the same penalty), and nīte may mean "taken away / removed"; the sentence has no stated object. Rendered literally. setuc.chidām: the c is the usual chidām gemination (setu-cchid), not a typo.

words.gloss: whose use of the embankments is lost

hindi: अथवा जिस सीमा में सेतुओं का उपभोग नष्ट हो गया हो, उस सीमा को राजा उपकार के अनुसार बाँट दे। १४। यह सीमा-विवाद है।
english: Or the king should divide the boundary, [one] whose use of the embankments is lost, according to benefit. 14. Such is the boundary dispute.
notes: Contains the verse number "| 14 |" in the line. yathā-upakāram: "according to benefit / usefulness".

hindi: खेत के विवाद को पड़ोसी गाँवों के वृद्ध निपटाएँ।
english: The elders of the neighbouring villages should settle the field dispute.
notes: kuryuḥ literally "should make"; rendered "settle" as in unit 10.

hindi: उनमें मतभेद होने पर, जिस ओर बहुत से शुद्ध अथवा अनुमत हों, उस ओर से निर्णय करें, अथवा मध्य को ग्रहण करें।
english: If there is a division among them, from where many [are] pure or approved, from there they should settle [it]; or they should take the middle.
notes: dvaidhī-bhāva here "a state of being divided" (not the technical "dual policy"). niyaccheyuḥ: ni-√yam literally "restrain / determine"; "settle" is the sense chosen. "From where ... from there" probably means "on the side where"; the ellipsis is left. madhyam: "the middle" (a middle course / the middle view), not further specified.

hindi: जिस वास्तु को दोनों ने दूसरे का कहा हो, उसे राजा ले ले, और जिसका स्वामी खो गया हो उसे।
english: The king should take the homestead [that] both have declared [to be] another's, and [one] whose owner is lost.

text_flags.why: possible: long ā in parā; para + ukta would normally give parokta, so the printed parā may be a stray vowel mark

notes: Obscure compound tad-ubhaya-para-uktam; literally "that-both-other-said". Rendered as "declared by both as another's" with the bracketed supply; an alternative reading is "said by both of them to be the other's". The text of this unit is doubtful.

hindi: अथवा उपकार के अनुसार बाँट दे।
english: Or [he] should divide [it] according to benefit.
notes: Continues unit 17 (subject the king, object the homestead, both understood). Kept as a separate unit as printed.

words.gloss: in the case of a homestead

hindi: बलपूर्वक वास्तु ले लेने पर चोरी का दण्ड है।
english: In taking a homestead by force, [there is] the penalty for theft.
notes: prasahya is an absolutive used as a first member ("having forced").

hindi: कारणवश लेने पर, प्रयास और आजीविका की गणना करके बन्ध दे। २०। यह खेत का विवाद है।
english: In taking for a reason, having reckoned the effort and the livelihood, [one] should give the bandha. 20. Such is the field dispute.
notes: bandha is obscure here (literally "binding"; possibly a pledge, security or confinement) and is kept as bandha. kāraṇa-ādāne "taking for a reason / with a cause" is also uncertain. ājīva = livelihood (possibly "profit"). Contains the verse number "| 20 |".

words.gloss: in the removal of a boundary

hindi: मर्यादा हटाने पर प्रथम साहस-दण्ड।
english: For the removal of a boundary, the first fine for rashness.
notes: Nominal sentence, no copula. "First" = the lowest of the three grades of sāhasa-daṇḍa (not stated here).

words.gloss: in the breaking of a boundary

hindi: मर्यादा तोड़ने पर चौबीस पण।
english: For the breaking of a boundary, twenty-four paṇas.
notes: daṇḍa understood from context ("a penalty of twenty-four paṇas").

words.gloss: penance-groves, pastures, highways, cremation grounds, temples, sacrificial places, holy places

hindi: इससे तपोवन, चरागाह, राजमार्ग, श्मशान, देवालय, यज्ञ-स्थान और पुण्य-स्थानों के विवादों की व्याख्या की गई। २३। यह मर्यादाओं की स्थापना है।
english: By that, the disputes about penance-groves, pastures, highways, cremation grounds, temples, sacrificial places and holy places are explained. 23. Such is the establishing of boundaries.

text_flags.why: possible: stray space after ".-"; the compound runs on into the next token (...-sthāna-vivādāḥ)

notes: One compound printed over two tokens (tapo.vana ... sthāna.- / vivādā). Because the text is split by a space the word entries are: first token = the members, second = vivādāḥ. deva-kula "temple" is literally "god-house / family of the gods"; the division of yajana and puṇya-sthāna is uncertain. Formula "tena X vyākhyātāḥ" = "By that, X are explained" (plural). Contains the verse number "| 23 |".

words.gloss: having the neighbours as basis of credence

hindi: सभी के सभी विवाद पड़ोसियों के विश्वास पर आधारित हैं।
english: All disputes without exception have the neighbours as their basis of credence.
notes: pratyaya: "belief, trust, credence"; "testimony / evidence" is possible. The rendering is literal. sarva eva is regular sandhi for sarve eva.

words.gloss: of pastures, dry ground, fields, groves, threshing-floors, houses, vehicles, storehouses

hindi: चरागाह, स्थल, खेत, वृक्ष-समूह, खलिहान, घर, वाहन और कोठार में से प्रत्येक पहला हानि सहे।
english: Of pastures, dry ground, fields, groves, threshing-floors, houses, vehicles and storehouses, each earlier one should bear the harm.
notes: The relation is probably: the earlier item in the list bears the harm done by the later one; the text does not say so. ṣaṇḍa "grove" (literally a cluster, a clump of trees) and vāhana "vehicle" are literal. Ordering of the list is as printed.

words.gloss: excluding brahma, soma, forest, god, sacrifice, holy places

hindi: ब्रह्म, सोम, अरण्य, देव, यजन और पुण्य स्थानों को छोड़कर स्थल-प्रदेश।
english: Tracts of dry ground, excluding the brahma, soma, forest, god, sacrifice and holy places.
notes: Obscure: brahma-sthāna / soma-sthāna are kept literal ("brahma", "soma" places); the division of the long compound (brahma-, soma-, araṇya-, deva-, yajana-, puṇya- before sthāna) is uncertain. The sentence is incomplete (it likely continues the rule of unit 25).

words.gloss: through the use of reservoirs, overflow-channels, fields
in injury to ploughed seed in another's field

hindi: आधार, परिवाह और खेतों के उपभोग से दूसरे के खेत में जुते हुए बीज की हानि होने पर, हानि के अनुसार मूल्य दें।
english: In the injury to ploughed seed in another's field through the use of reservoirs, overflow-channels [and] fields, they should pay the value according to the damage.
notes: parivāha: "overflow / drain" (of a reservoir); kṛṣṭa-bīja: literally "ploughed seed". The subject of dadyuḥ (the users) is not stated.

hindi: खेतों, उद्यानों और सेतु-बन्धों की परस्पर हानि होने पर हानि का दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: In mutual injury of fields, gardens [and] embankment-dams, the penalty is double the injury.
notes: setu-bandha could also be read as two items, embankments and dams.

hindi: बाद में बना निचला तालाब ऊपरी तालाब के खेत को जल से न डुबोए।
english: The lower tank, settled later, should not flood the field of the upper tank with water.
notes: paścāt-niviṣṭam read with adhara-taṭākam as "the lower tank established later".

words.gloss: of one whose work has ceased for three years

hindi: ऊपर बना तालाब निचले तालाब के भराव और बहाव को न रोके, तीन वर्ष से जिसका कार्य बन्द है उसके अतिरिक्त।
english: A [tank] established above should not obstruct the filling and outflow of the lower tank, except [in the case] of one whose work has ceased for three years.
notes: taṭākam is understood with upari-niviṣṭam. Whose work has ceased (the owner of the lower tank, presumably) is not stated. pūra-āsrāva: "filling (flood) and outflow".

words.gloss: causing the tank to vomit out

hindi: उसका उल्लंघन होने पर प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है, और तालाब का वमन कराना।
english: On transgression of that, the first fine for rashness, and the causing of the tank to vomit out.
notes: vāmana (from caus. √vam) is kept literal ("causing to vomit out"); the sense "draining / emptying out of the tank" is likely but not stated. tasya refers to the rule of unit 30.

words.gloss: of one whose work has ceased for five years

hindi: पाँच वर्ष से जिसका कार्य बन्द है, उस सेतु-बन्ध का स्वामित्व लुप्त हो जाए, आपत्तियों को छोड़कर।
english: Of an embankment-dam whose work has ceased for five years, the ownership would be lost, except because of adversities.
notes: The bahuvrīhi pañca-varṣa-uparata-karmaṇaḥ agrees with setu-bandhasya (genitive). anyatra āpadbhyaḥ: "except on account of adversities" (āpad = adversity).

hindi: तालाबों और सेतु-बन्धों के नए आरम्भ पर पाँच वर्ष की छूट है; टूटे और छोड़े हुए की चार वर्ष की, चढ़े हुए की तीन वर्ष की, स्थल की दो वर्ष की।
english: For the new starting of tanks and embankment-dams, an exemption of five years; for the broken and abandoned, of four years; for those grown over, of three years; for dry ground, of two years.
notes: samupārūḍha (sam-upa-ā-√ruh, "risen up / grown over") is obscure; the rendering "grown over" is literal and uncertain. nava-pravartana: "new starting / setting going". "Dry ground" = sthala.

words.gloss: in the pledging of one's own self

hindi: अपने आत्म को बन्धक रखने और बेचने में।
english: In the pledging of one's own self, and in sale.
notes: Fragment with no stated predicate; it probably continues units 32-33 (loss of rights / exemption in case of pledge or sale), but this is not stated. sva-ātma may refer to the work-owner himself; the reading is uncertain.

words.gloss: of non-river bindings, abodes, tanks, fields, gardens, groves, sowings

hindi: खुदाई के कार्य को तथा नदी-रहित बन्धों, आयतनों, तालाबों, खेतों, उद्यानों, वृक्ष-समूहों और बोई भूमियों के फसल-प्रकार-भाग के आगे वाले अंश को वे दूसरों को अथवा उपकार के अनुसार दें।
english: They should give the work of digging, and the further share of crop-kinds, of the non-river bindings, abodes, tanks, fields, gardens, groves [and] sowings, to others or according to benefit.
notes: Very obscure; rendered literally with no guessed senses. Doubtful words: khāta-prāvṛtti ("digging-undertaking"), anadī-nibandha (binding / fastening not of a river), āyatana (abode), vāpa (sowing / tank), sasya-varṇa-bhāga-uttarika (a "further / later share" by kinds of crop). The attachment of the objects is uncertain.

words.gloss: purchase, hire, additional share, released for enjoyment, users

hindi: क्रय, अवक्रय, अधिभाग और भोग के लिए छोड़ी हुई वस्तु के उपभोक्ता, इनका प्रतिकार करें।
english: [Those by] purchase, hire, additional share, [and] release for enjoyment, and the users, should remedy these.

text_flags.why: possible: compound dot missing between bhoga and niṣṛṣṭa

notes: Obscure; the compound is read as a list (prakraya "purchase", avakraya "hire", adhibhāga "additional share", bhoga-niṣṛṣṭa "released for enjoyment", upabhoktāraḥ "users"); whether these are persons holding by those titles is not stated. pratikṛ with the genitive "to requite / make good" is also possible; "remedy" follows the glossary (pratīkāra).

hindi: प्रतिकार न करने पर कमी का दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: When there is no remedy, the penalty is double the shortfall.

text_flags.why: possible: stray r for a (apratīkāre, "in non-remedy"), in view of pratikuryuḥ in unit 36

notes: The reading apratīkāre is a suggested correction; "arpatīkāra" gives no known word. hīna: "deficient / shortfall" (as in the glossary for 4.1).

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. upa-√rudh

hindi: बाँधों से बिना बारी के जल छोड़ने वाले का दण्ड छह पण है; अथवा बारी पर दूसरों के जल को प्रमादवश रोकने वाले का।
english: For one releasing water from the embankments out of turn, the fine is six paṇas; or [for one] who, at the turn, obstructs the water of others through negligence.
notes: avāre literally "at a non-turn". "Or [the same fine]" is understood for the second line, whose genitive uparundhataḥ parallels muñcataḥ. Whose turn it is in the second line is not stated.
